title: Canon of the Twin Mirror Minds
summary: A canon of setting two mirrors of soul against each other so that every touch shows its sender and every sender is read to the bottom.

title: Treatise of the Azure Far-Seeing
summary: A treatise on thinning the soul to clear blue air and sending it far past sight to read the souls of distant companies.

title: The Hawk and Basin Mastery
summary: A mastery of the high watching soul that gathers all feeling into a basin below and stoops on the one soul about to spill.

title: Paired Heart Hearing Canon
summary: A canon of hearing two hearts as one beat and binding a company into a single pulse that feels its own wounds.

title: Treatise of the Court of Two Minds
summary: A treatise on keeping a second mind in council beside the first so that every soul read is also judged.

title: The Plateau Hearing Canon
summary: A canon of listening across open level ground where no soul can hide and every gust of intent carries.

title: Treatise of the Sworn Watcher
summary: A treatise on the oath of the watcher who swears never to sleep while those in the watcher's charge are in danger.

title: The Bearing Beyond Sight Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of taking a true bearing on souls that no eye can see and steering a whole company by them.

title: Manual of the Wind-Carried Ken
summary: A manual of riding the sensing soul on a steady wind so that it travels a great distance and returns with all it met.

title: The Oath of Open Ears
summary: A discipline of swearing the soul open to every cry for help within its reach and holding that oath through any danger.
